description: Check a purchase started with start_purchase. Returns its state: awaiting_deposit (send the amount), deposit_seen, processing, paid (the order is recorded and the seller was paid), refunded (funds returned to refund_to), failed, expired (deadline passed without a deposit) or review (being checked by Port66). Also returns links to the buyer's payment and the seller's payout transactions and, once paid, the order_id. Poll every 15 to 30 seconds while the state is awaiting_deposit, deposit_seen or processing. Requires a Port66 session.
name: purchase_status
title: Purchase status
